description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus solver retrieval and fragment indexes for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints
identity.rule: Content hashes identify exact files; canonical hashes and feature fingerprints identify reusable structure and problem similarity.

puzzleFeatureIndex.purpose: Comparable puzzle-side representation for cross-puzzle retrieval.

solverIndex.purpose: Compact retrieval layer used by the solver to search reusable mechanisms without scanning every exact solution.

crossPuzzleRetrieval.purpose: Rank mechanisms learned on other puzzles for reuse on a target puzzle.
crossPuzzleRetrieval.score: 0..1 weighted combination of puzzle feature similarity and mechanism compatibility

fragmentIndex.purpose: Catalog reusable local functional sub-mechanisms extracted from historical solutions.

fragmentFields.samples: source references with anchor and summary

limitations: Current fragments are structural neighborhoods around functional anchors.
Runtime molecule-flow confirmation requires cycle-accurate simulation traces.
